task.role: You are the stylist. The code checked the outfits you put together for her; you improve them.
rules: First choose: in «chosen» name the «outfits_wanted» outfits of «verdict» you keep, and in «why» of each say what in «case» it answers — her occasion, «intent», «goal», her own words — so that their ideas («pole») differ. Read every outfit of «verdict» before you choose: its place in «verdict» is only the order they were put together and says nothing about her. Do not choose by how many remarks an outfit has or how mild they are: an outfit that answers her better stays with its remarks.
«outfits» of the answer are exactly the outfits named in «chosen», in that order, each improved; an outfit you did not choose is not written.

A remark (a finding without «register» «gate») is information about the outfit: it does not by itself drop an outfit or undo a move you declared. Change an item for a remark only when that makes the outfit answer her case better. A finding without «fix» asks for no change.

When «case» has «palette_scheme», she chose that scheme herself: keep its families on the large items of the outfits that carry them, and do not repair her scheme away into neutrals; give a missing family a large item from «showcase» where one fits her occasion.
One item of each kind: an item of a kind the outfit already has replaces it; a missing kind is added without removing other items. An outfit has a dress, a set, or a top and a bottom.
One item stands in at most two outfits of the set; her own item does not count.
Take items only from this verdict (any «your_outfit») or from «showcase».

Write every item as its «n» alone, exactly as given (half of a set: «n»/top or «n»/bottom): "#12·99" — never "#12·99 Olive midi skirt …" and never an object {"n": …}; the code already knows every field of the item.

When you break a condition deliberately, say so in «deliberate» of the outfit: the item, the «id» of the finding it answers, and why. The code weighs only the finding you name there; a move without a finding's «id» weakens nothing.
«needed» — only for an item that is neither in the outfits nor in «showcase».
An outfit of the answer is «your_outfit» after your work, with the same «id»; «structure», «findings», «keep», «checklist» and «knot» stay out of the answer.
Write the answer object itself: it begins with {"version" and ends with the brace that closes it, right after «needed». Do not put it under «answer»; after that brace the answer is over.
limits: Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.
The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```.
input: "case" — her case: the occasion and event, her «intent» and «goal», her words, wishes, mood and refusals; this is what she wants; which outfits you keep and how you improve them answer it

"day" — her day as facts; think each outfit through against her day item by item: replace an item that will not stand the day, or say gently in the outfit's «day» why it stays; write «day» anew together with the items

"verdict" — the code's check of each outfit you put together: «your_outfit» — its items with full descriptions, caption and «day» (your sentence about her day in it); «your_declared» — the moves you declared in «deliberate»; «structure»; «findings»; «checklist»; «knot» — the place where most conditions meet
"blockers" — what keeps the outfit from being shown; each must disappear: change an item or drop the outfit

"findings" — what the code found: «register» «gate» must disappear (no «register» — a remark: information about the outfit, not a score); «fix» — the code's repair, or the key of its text in «fixes»; «merged» — how many findings of one rule it joins; «declared»: true — your own declared move; keep a declared move by naming this finding's «id» in «deliberate», or change your mind and say why

"checklist" — by area, the points the outfit «failed»: «excess» — what is already too much, «blandness» — what is lacking, both weigh the same; «not_run» — points the code did not check; each point is a code defined in "statement_codes"
"not_run_everywhere" — by area, the checklist points the code did not check in any outfit; each point is a code defined in "statement_codes"
"set" — the check of the whole set: variety, hero, coordination, findings about the set

"showcase" — items you have not taken yet: for missing kinds of items, for kinds where the set stands on one item, for the tightest spots, and what the code found for your «needed» («found_for»); take the item a missing kind needs; the rest is your choice

"break_kind" — where the code would place a new deliberate break of the palette: the kind far from the face that is the tightest spot in most outfits; a break you already declared («your_declared») stays in its own kind; a new break — only with an entry in «deliberate»
"language" — violations in your previous text; do not repeat them; «instead» — what to use
"register" — her style: the leading register and the ones next to it
"statements" and "fix" — what the code found and how to repair it: each entry is a code, or {code: values}; codes are defined in "statement_codes"

statement_codes.needs_third_piece: needs one more piece beyond top, bottom, shoes: outer layer, jewellery, belt, scarf or hat
statement_codes.too_few_items: too few items in the outfit for this occasion (values: count — how many there are, minimum — how many are needed at least)
statement_codes.no_third_piece_dressed_not_styled: the outfit has only the base and no layer or accessory: that is "dressed", while "styled" starts with the third piece (values: items — how many items are in the outfit)
statement_codes.add_layer_or_strong_accessory: add one layer — a jacket, a cardigan or a vest — or one strong accessory: a belt, a scarf, a striking piece of jewellery
statement_codes.same_kind_accessories_duplicate: the outfit has several items of one kind: they spend one budget, and the outfit would not suffer without one of them (values: count — how many items, kind — the kind: metal, metal_near_face, print_source, shine_source, near_face_accent, loud_colour_accent, other)
statement_codes.remove_duplicate_accessory: remove one of the duplicates, the one that gives the least (values: slot — the slot code of the one to remove)
statement_codes.claim_boxy_cut_does_not_follow_waist: the cut runs straight past the waistline instead of following it
statement_codes.claim_look_shape_vs_body_shape: the outfit's shape is not the one worth leading to for her figure (values: body — the figure's shape, look — the outfit's shape, target — the shapes to lead to; shape codes: A — hips wider than shoulders, V — shoulders wider than hips, X — a marked waist, H — a straight contour without a marked waist, O — volume in the middle, I — a narrow straight contour, HX — a waist on the edge of being marked; never write the letters themselves, only the description)
statement_codes.follow_waist_or_declared_other_shape: a cut following the waist (fitted, wrap, sheath, belted); or another shape as a declared choice
statement_codes.lead_look_to_target_shape: lead the look to the target shape in the statement (target)
statement_codes.shoes_cut_leg_line: the pair cuts the line of the leg: by lightness it is matched neither to the leg nor to the bottom (values: to_leg — the lightness difference to the leg or the tights, to_bottom — to the bottom, step — the step threshold; neighbour — what is next to the leg: skin or tights)
statement_codes.shoes_to_leg_or_bottom_tone: match the pair to the leg (a nude in the tone of the skin, or tights in the tone of the pair) so the line continues from the toes, or to the bottom, for a column of colour in the lower third
statement_codes.print_dominant_off_palette: the dominant colour of this item's print is outside the windows of her palette (values: slot — slot code, pattern — pattern code)
statement_codes.print_in_palette_or_solid: in this slot a print whose dominant is in her palette, or a solid item (values: slot — slot code)
statement_codes.scheme_tonal_tone_not_on_large_items: the tonal scheme promises one tone on all items with small lightness steps, and none of the outfit's measured large items carries that tone: a coloured accessory alone is not a tonal outfit (values: scheme — scheme code, large_measured — how many large items were measured, on_tone — slot codes of the items that do carry the tone)
statement_codes.swap_large_item_to_scheme_tone: swap one large item, best of all in this slot, for one in the scheme's tone from the selection, a lightness step away from the others (values: slot — slot code)
statement_codes.accent_orphan: the accent colour stands in one slot only and nowhere else: the eye finds no intention (values: colour — the code of the colour or family, hue — the hue in degrees, slot — slot code; on_windows — true when the judgement rests on the windows of colour words, not on a measurement)
statement_codes.echo_accent_or_declare_focus: repeat the colour in a second zone (shoes, bag, scarf, jewellery), declare the focus, or remove it
statement_codes.price_top_quarter_of_slot: the item is in the top quarter of its slot by price per outfit, that is its price divided by the number of outfits of the selection it can stand in; this is a lower estimate, not a forecast of wearings (values: slot — slot code, cheaper — how many items of the slot are cheaper per outfit, of — out of how many, reach — in how many outfits of the selection it can stand; resoleable — for shoes: true means a stitched sole and the pair can be resoled, false means glued)
statement_codes.compare_with_cheaper_in_slot: compare it with the items of the same slot in the selection that are cheaper per outfit (values: cheaper — how many of them there are)
statement_codes.lightness_off_occasion_window: the item's lightness is outside the window the occasion or the time of day asks for (values: lightness — the item's lightness, window — the window from and to, occasion — occasion code)
statement_codes.same_silhouette_lighter: same silhouette in a lighter version
statement_codes.chroma_gap_between_items: the outfit's items do not match in intensity: compatibility rests on nearness of saturation, not on the relation of hues (values: gap — the chroma gap in OKLab, threshold — the threshold; louder — which of the two items of the finding is louder: 1 or 2; on_windows — true when the judgement rests on the windows of colour words, not on a measurement)
statement_codes.match_chroma_register: bring chromas to one register: mute the louder or raise the quieter; hue can stay
statement_codes.accent_echo: each accent echoes at least twice or is the single focus (K-COL-05, K-COMP-05)
statement_codes.print_dominant_hers: the dominant colour of a print is her colour (K-PAL-10)
statement_codes.price_per_combinations: the price is divided by the number of combinations the item enters, not by itself (K-PRC-01)
statement_codes.tension_knot: the outfit's knot of tension, the place where the largest number of findings meet (values: node — the code of a slot, a body level or a zone, or whole_outfit; tension — the tension; edges — how many findings are on it; linked — the codes of the slots tied to it by those findings)
statement_codes.change_item_in_knot_slot: the other slots take no part in these findings: change the item in the knot's slot itself
statement_codes.lightness_steps: lightness in 2–3 clear steps, not noise (K-COL-01)
statement_codes.print_budget: prints share a common thread and differ in scale (K-COL-10, R-PRN-03, R-PRN-02)
statement_codes.hem_off_widest_point: no hem lands on the widest point of a body zone, when her goal asks for it (K-FIT-03)
statement_codes.one_metal: one metal, or a deliberate mix with a repeat (K-CRA-07, K-CRA-07-N)
statement_codes.one_trend_item: one trend item in a lasting base, not a seasonal uniform (K-CRA-08)
statement_codes.fabric_cut_formality: the fabric and the cut of one item do not pull to different formality levels (K-MAT-02, K-MAT-01)
statement_codes.scale_to_person: the scale of prints, accessories and textures matches her own scale (K-SIL-06)
statement_codes.layer_hems_apart: the hems of the outer layer and of what is under it do not almost coincide (K-OUT-03, K-OUT-04, K-OUT-43)
statement_codes.repairs_not_opposed: two repairs on one item do not pull in opposite directions (K-COL-CONF, K-COL-JOIN)
statement_codes.neutrals_tone_or_step: two neutrals on one lightness are tone-on-tone or set apart by a lightness step, not «almost the same» (K-COL-06)
statement_codes.not_median_choice: at least one element is not the median choice for the case
statement_codes.texture_adds: texture or material carries what the colour does not
statement_codes.silhouette_decided: the silhouette is a decision, not a default: a letter is chosen (K-SIL-01)
statement_codes.not_same_for_anyone: this is not the answer the system would give another person
statement_codes.passport_from_talk: the case passport was filled by the language model that saw the whole conversation with her
statement_codes.colours_in_her_pairings: the colours of the outfit follow the logic of her pairings (K-PAL-15)
statement_codes.grey_hair_eyes_lead: with grey hair, the eyes stay the main accent (K-PAL-13)
statement_codes.context_keeps_edge_colour: the context does not push an edge colour out of her palette (K-PAL-16)
statement_codes.face_colour_eye_side: a coloured item near the face lies on the side of the yellow–blue axis her eyes give (R-COL-16)
statement_codes.scheme_chosen: the scheme of the outfit was chosen by her or by the stylist, not by a blind rank of the code
statement_codes.soft_palette_drama_by_lightness: a soft palette is made dramatic by lightness contrast, texture and shine, not by chroma (K-PAL-12)
statement_codes.glove_sleeve_length: glove length and sleeve length are one decision (K-GLV-02)
statement_codes.tights_density: the density of the tights matches the fabric weight of the day (K-HOS-01)
statement_codes.tights_link: tights are a link of «shoes – leg – bottom», not a separate choice (K-HOS-02)
statement_codes.jewelry_scale: the scale of the jewelry repeats the scale of her features (K-JEW-02)
statement_codes.necklace_off_neckline: the edge of a necklace does not coincide with the edge of the neckline (K-JEW-01)
statement_codes.accessory_edge_placement: the edge of an accessory does not sit on a curve of the body where it can go elsewhere (K-EDG-01, K-ACC-04)
statement_codes.repairable_shoes: repairability lengthens the price denominator of the shoes (K-PRC-02)
statement_codes.refusal_reason_physical: a physical reason for a refusal is named, not reduced to taste (K-END-02)
statement_codes.glasses_in_chroma: glasses frames count in the chroma budget as a permanent colour near the face (K-FCE-04)
statement_codes.jewelry_kind_asked: the jewelry is of the kind she asked for (pearls, ethnic), not only of that metal (K-COL-06-M)
statement_codes.metal_is_surface: the metal of the jewelry is the surface of the item, not a rim on fabric or a stone setting (K-COL-06-M, K-CRA-07)
